title: Build lines is hidden, not greyed out, until the inspection is ready
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. Seed cases covering: a completed inspection with no Monitor/Not OK findings; a user without "Work order lines - Create & Edit"; an inspection that is not completed; and an organisation without ShopCoach.
custom_steps:
1. On an inspection with no Monitor/Not OK findings, confirm the action is not shown.
2. As a user without 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', confirm the action is absent, not disabled.
3. On a not-completed inspection, confirm the action is not shown.
4. In an organisation without ShopCoach, confirm no build action at all — only View PDF and a work-order link, absent (not disabled, no tooltip).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If the inspection has no Monitor or Not OK findings, the action is not shown.
  • Without 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', the action is absent, not disabled.
  • If the inspection is not completed, the action is not shown.
  • Without ShopCoach, no build action is shown — only View PDF and a work-order link — and it is absent, not disabled and not behind a tooltip.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9101 (S3 — Build from a completed inspection); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S3; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-N1: “If the inspection has no Monitor or Not OK findings, the action will not be shown”
  • S3-N2: “If the user does not have 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' enabled, the action will not be shown. It will be absent, not disabled”
  • S3-N3: “If the inspection is not completed, the action will not be shown”
  • S3-N4: “If the organisation does not have ShopCoach, no build action is shown. The screen offers View PDF and a link to the work order and nothing else — the action is absent, not disabled and not behind a tooltip (S2-R0)”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
